name: Shoo Hoo Run
summary: Shoo Hoo Run is an immersive VR horror game that combines intense gameplay with spine-chilling moments, delivering a truly unique experience for players. Set in a dark, atmospheric environment, the game challenges players to survive against terrifying monsters that lurk around every corner. As a player, you’ll need to utilize a range of special staff items that help you navigate and fend off the creatures that threaten your safety.
